fact: ANIP said on 16 August 2025 the LEI would be displayed provisionally in every voting centre from 13 to 28 September 2025 and definitively from 28 October to 11 November 2025.
title: Élections générales de 2026 au Bénin : La LEI et les plateformes numériques de l'ANIP
